output.reason: The upgrade guide lists this under Breaking Changes [ev-01e97dc9c4df]. It says the wildcard view permission was removed and replaced by a role binding to the default `view` role. As a result the controller "may no longer be able to view these custom resources", which may affect reports and mutate/generate policies, while admission-control policies are not affected. The chart renders confirm that the */*:get, list and watch rules were removed from the admission, background and reports controller ClusterRoles [ev-6af5be55b5f4][ev-0ae726bec846][ev-fbb2a078179b][ev-8034700c2e78]. Losing access a component relies on is permission-lost, and the proposed statement, remediation and medium severity stay within the evidence; whether a given environment's custom resources are outside the `view` role is an applicability question, not part of the consequence.
